provenance: Copied from DamSafety_Core/damsuite/tm11_curves.py CURVES / AXES (DWR_Plugins main e12f35d; table SHA-256 2fb490ca2f082ff3939a7990351484a81f91f2ceee052e6331c4f0ab2c8a4a2f): ND Dam Safety Standards REG_05.2026 Figures 5.1 and 5.2 (Reclamation 1988, ACER TM 11 Figures 2 and 3), digitized by the engineer (flood_danger_classifier.py, stated accuracy +/-0.06 ft). Signed off by Nicholas Bendickson on 2026-10-12. Not re-digitized. damit_hazard/tests/test_tm11.py checks this file against the Core table when the repository copy is present.
rule: Straight lines between the tabulated velocities; a velocity past the chart's axis or a depth above its axis takes the high danger zone; a negative velocity is read at 0; a depth ON a boundary takes the higher zone (the DamSafety suite rule).
